02

The hero loads late and the gallery is oversized

The homepage’s 686 KB office background is discovered late with mobile lab LCP of 8.9–12.1 seconds, while Office Tour separately downloads 21 full-size photos totaling 13.87 MB before scrolling.

  • Homepage: compress cr-smiles-dental-facade-2.webp, serve a smaller mobile version and discover the active first-screen image early with a matched high-priority preload or HTML image, without lazy-loading or duplicate downloads.
  • Office Tour: serve responsive thumbnails with srcset/sizes, lazy-load below-screen photos and load originals only for enlargement; start with office-15 (1.05 MB) and office-16 (994 KB).
03

Two pages show a later opening time

Contact and Scheduling show Tuesday/Thursday opening at 10am, but the exact Google profile, homepage and Dentist schema show 9am.

  • Contact → Office Hours: change “Tuesday and Thursday : 10am to 6pm” to “Tuesday and Thursday : 9am to 6pm”.
  • Scheduling → opening paragraph: change “Tuesday and Thursday from 10am to 6pm” to “Tuesday and Thursday from 9am to 6pm”, using Google’s hours as the correct source.
04

Useful pages have no visitor path

Ten articles and Areas Served have no incoming links in the checked site, and the Blog listing itself returns HTTP 404.

  • Create a working /blog/ listing containing the ten existing articles, then add About → Blog linking to that listing.
  • Add About → Areas Served linking to the existing /areas-served/ hub; preserve the current About menu items.

Fix order

Correct the article links and two opening-time blocks, then improve image delivery and add the missing About-menu paths.

  • Add the three exact redirects and ten direct article-link corrections; change the two Tuesday/Thursday opening times from 10am to 9am.
  • Optimize the homepage hero and Office Tour gallery, then add a working Blog listing and Areas Served under About.

Selected findings from the read-only audit, not proof of ranking loss or a Google penalty. Speed figures are lab tests; field CWV is unavailable. Redirect maps are checked recommendations, not installed rules or a full historical URL inventory. No website or Google-profile changes were made.
